questions.question: Do I need to configure anything after installing the SDK?
questions.answer: No. The agent configuration files are included in the npm package. Your AI coding assistant reads them automatically when you open a project with MoneyGraph installed.

questions.question: Which AI agents are supported?
questions.answer: We support the Big 5: GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, Windsurf (Codeium), Devin, and Cursor. We also support Claude.ai, Lovable, and GPT/OpenAI via tool schemas.

questions.question: Does the AI understand compliance requirements?
questions.answer: Yes. Our configuration files teach AI agents to always check KYC status before payouts, use environment variables for secrets, and follow the Quote → Confirm → Payout pattern.

questions.question: Can I customize the rules for my team?
questions.answer: Yes. The configuration files are in standard formats (Markdown, JSON, MDC). You can extend them with your own team-specific rules.

questions.question: What if my AI still generates incorrect code?
questions.answer: Try adding inline comments like '// Use MoneyGraph SDK' to prime the AI. If issues persist, check that node_modules/@moneygraph/sdk exists in your workspace.
